item.title: Washington, D.C.'s first IndyCar race packed the National Mall
item.description: IndyCar drivers raced past famous landmarks this weekend, facing new challenges on an unconventional track.

item.title: Thousands forced to evacuate parts of Reno, Nevada, as new wildfire rages
item.description: Officials say the fire, which has burned over 15,000 acres and is zero percent contained, was human caused. Nearly 90,000 people have been evacuated.

item.title: National Guard members reflect on extended D.C. deployment
item.description: Three guard members who served months in Washington describe their experience as the deployment continues into its second year.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Treasury secretary outlines new economic measures against Iran, while Iran warns of severe retaliation if threats proceed.
